name: bulletproof-large-context
description: Rules in a large always-loaded file against lint rules: the same bulletproof-react tasks, rules and checkers as bulletproof-notify-querykey (arms, plugin and ESLint config are symlinks to it). In the _large arms the always-loaded file also holds the project's AGENTS.md and all nine guides from docs/, verbatim; the two rules sit where prose_buried puts them, so prose_loaded_large is buried prose that is always loaded. Plan 3 in studies/analysis-plan.md.

tasks.prompt: In apps/react-vite, let the author of a comment edit it: add an update-comment API (PATCH /comments/{commentId} with the new body) and an Edit button with a form drawer in the comments list, shown only on the current user's own comments. Show a success message after saving. Do not run tests, lint or the app.

In apps/react-vite, let admins change a user's role from the users list: add an update-user-role API (PATCH /users/{userId}/role with the new role) and a role select in each row of the users table. The list must show the new role after the change, and a success message should appear. Do not run tests, lint or the app.

fix.prompt: Code review feedback on your uncommitted change in apps/react-vite: it breaks two project rules. Success notifications are shown inside the mutation hook in the feature's api/ folder (in onSuccess); feature components must not call useNotifications. Query keys come from the feature's query options (for example getUsersQueryOptions().queryKey); literal key arrays are only allowed inside queryOptions(...). Fix the new code accordingly; tests are not affected. Do not run tests, lint or the app.
